technical_and_design_decisions: For U1 (job creation bug), we will implement enhanced logging and role-based access diagnostics to identify the root cause.
For U2 (explicit partition count), we will add a configuration property 'kafka.partition.count' to the Kafka source module and update the consumer assignment logic accordingly.
For U3 (dynamic partition subscription), we will leverage Kafka's consumer rebalance listener and dynamic partition assignment API to allow runtime subscription changes.
For U4 (Syncable writes), we will implement an option 'hdfs.syncable' that uses HDFS's Syncable interface to force data to disk on each write, accepting a performance trade-off.
For U5 (no .tmp suffix), we will add an option 'hdfs.temp.suffix=false' to write directly to the target file, with appropriate handling of partial writes.
For U6 (custom module upload via Maven/Gradle), we will create a Maven plugin and Gradle task that packages and deploys custom modules to the Spring XD repository via REST API.
For U7 (custom module versioning), we will extend the module metadata to include version fields and implement version resolution and upgrade/downgrade logic.
For U8 (certification against PHD 3.0), we will update the compatibility matrix, run the full test suite on PHD 3.0, and fix any incompatibilities in Hadoop client dependencies.
assumptions: The development is for a single developer with senior-level expertise in Java, Spring, Kafka, HDFS, and build tools.
The target platform is Spring XD (or a similar data pipeline framework) with an existing codebase and test infrastructure.
All user stories are to be developed in a single software increment with no external dependencies or blockers.
Testing environments (e.g., a running Kafka cluster, HDFS cluster, PHD 3.0 cluster) are available for development and testing.
The existing codebase follows standard Spring Boot conventions and uses Maven for build management.
Time estimates include analysis, design, implementation, unit testing, and code review for each feature, plus integration testing and documentation across the increment.

activities.activity_name: Investigate and fix U1 bug (job creation error with roles)
activities.activity_description: Reproduce the error, analyze logs, identify root cause (possibly missing permission checks or UI/logging gaps), implement fix, and add unit/integration tests.

activities.activity_name: Implement explicit partition count configuration for Kafka source (U2)
activities.activity_description: Add configuration property for partition count, update Kafka consumer setup to use fixed partition assignment when configured, write unit tests.

activities.activity_name: Implement dynamic partition subscription for Kafka source (U3)
activities.activity_description: Add support for runtime partition subscription changes using consumer rebalance listeners and dynamic partitioning API, handle state transitions, write tests.

activities.activity_name: Implement Syncable writes option for HDFS sink (U4)
activities.activity_description: Create optional Syncable write mode using HDFS Syncable interface, add configuration flag, modify sink to call sync() after each write, document performance impact, write tests.

activities.activity_name: Implement option to skip temporary .tmp suffix for HDFS sink (U5)
activities.activity_description: Add configuration flag to disable temporary file suffix, modify file writing to write directly to final filename with appropriate failure handling, write tests.

activities.activity_name: Implement custom module upload via Maven/Gradle targets (U6)
activities.activity_description: Design and implement Maven plugin and Gradle task to package custom modules and upload them via REST API to the Spring XD repository, including authentication and error handling.
Extend module metadata model with version fields, implement version resolution and validation, support upgrade/downgrade workflows, write tests.
Set up PHD 3.0 test environment, run full test suite, diagnose and fix any incompatibilities (e.g., Hadoop client API changes), update documentation and configuration for PHD 3.0.

activities.activity_name: Design and architecture review for all features
activities.activity_description: Review overall design decisions, ensure consistency across features, produce design notes and update existing architecture documentation.

activities.activity_name: Write unit tests for all new features
activities.activity_description: Create comprehensive unit tests for each feature's core logic, including edge cases and configuration variations.
Set up integration test scenarios covering all user stories, run end-to-end tests, debug and fix any integration issues.
Update user guides, configuration reference, and API documentation for all new features and changes.
Review all code changes for quality, consistency, and adherence to coding standards; perform minor refactoring as needed.
